Knowledge Hub

Courses, dictionary, assignments and exam practice — the student side of MouRa.

Uses the built-in packs and databases — works with zero internet, instantly.

No key or setup is needed — Class AI (shared) already works for everyone: pick it in the HOW TO WRITE IT chips above. Optional: switch on AI so any topic — any course, any crop, creative essays — gets a full AI-written assignment in the MouRa format. The Free online AI option needs no account and no key (compact output, slower, experimental); the key options write longer assignments. The ten flagship topics always use their verified offline packs. Your key is stored only in this browser and sent only to the AI provider you choose.

Free keys: aistudio.google.com/apikey (Gemini) or console.groq.com/keys (Groq). The key is stored only in this browser and sent only to the provider you choose. Internet is needed only while generating.

Two writing engines, your choice every time: Offline writes instantly from the verified packs and built-in databases with zero internet; Free AI (no key) and My AI key write any topic - any course, any crop, creative essays - live online in the same format. Always verify facts and write in your own words before submission.
